summary: Full backend + frontend verification of Control4-style home controller. All 20 pytest backend tests pass. Frontend PIN gate, all 6 tabs (Home/Watch/Listen/Climate/Security/Scenes), driver drawer, and state persistence across reload all function correctly. No critical bugs found.
action_items: Optional (naming consistency with review request testids): review request specified 'camera-snapshot', 'camera-fullscreen', 'reset-system' but implementation uses 'camera-snapshot-btn', 'camera-fullscreen-btn', 'reset-system-btn'. Functionality is correct; only the testid suffixes differ. Update review request or remove the -btn suffix for consistency.
Optional: review request lists remote key 'ok' and 'play', while implementation uses 'select' (OK) and 'playpause'/'pause'. Buttons fire correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /api/audio/group ignores req.volume for setting log entries and never emits amp.set_volume commands for the group operation — only set_source is logged. Volume IS applied to state but there is no per-zone volume driver log entry, and no mute clear log entry either. Minor logging gap.

server.py POST /api/audio/zone: when req.source is provided and src is None (invalid source id) the code silently uses the raw id instead of returning 404. Consider validating and returning 404 for unknown source_id.

drivers.py ThermostatDriver.set formats value inside quotes always (e.g. numeric temps become strings in the JSON payload string). Cosmetic only (demo mode), but real Ecobee call would send string values.
server.py: On PIN mismatch endpoint returns 200 with success:false. Consider 401 for real auth; current UX depends on this design.
PinLock uses backend /auth/pin verification for every attempt — fine, but there is no lockout / rate-limit.
test_credentials: PIN: 1234; demo bypass button data-testid='pin-demo-bypass' works
seed_data_creation: None — backend seeds default_state() on first GET /api/state or on POST /api/state/reset.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (20 tests, all pass). Frontend testids confirmed in scripts above.
